as_told.title: Princeton PEAR lab and SRI psi research

plain: Michels says that serious researchers at elite American institutions ran experiments with random event generators, machines that churn out random numbers, to test whether the human mind could nudge them. He tells it himself across several episodes, once citing a researcher named Jessica Utts, another time naming the Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research Lab, known as PEAR, and SRI, a research institute, and once saying PEAR was started by Robert Jahn, then dean of Princeton's engineering school; his point is that mind-over-matter research was taken seriously at the top of academia.
